title: Goals
subtitle: Savings goals. The money stays in your savings account; a goal only records how much is for what.
emptyBody: A goal sets aside part of a savings account for something you want.
reachNone: Set a contribution to see when it is reached
emergencyNone: Needs three periods of spending to show months
freeBody: Savings not set aside for any goal.
over: {amount} more is set aside than this account holds. Choose which goal gives it up.
chooseGoals: This dips {amount} into money set aside for goals. Choose which goals give it up.
noSavings: Add an account with use "Savings" first.
allocation_exceeds_balance: That is more than the account holds after other goals.
choose_goals: Choose which goals give up the money.
depositHelp: Move new money from a daily account into savings, straight into this goal.
allocateHelp: Mark part of the balance already in a savings account for this goal. No money moves.
